attributes.name: Chalice of Ozem
attributes.powers:
Display this card next to a character at your location. While displayed, that character may add 1d6 to her checks. At the end of the turn, recharge this card.

Bury this card to get 2 mythic charges.

corrections.corrected_text: On the item Torc of the Heavens and the loots Ball of Twine, Chalice of Ozem, and Dawnflower's Kiss, add the Mythic trait.
corrections.issue: Should all boons that reference mythic charges have the Mythic trait?
